item.title: Jazz Brunch w/ “Four Peanuts” trio — Sat Nov 21, 11:30 AM — French Broad River Brewery
item.description:
Jazz Brunch is now officially on the schedule for every Saturday here in the taproom! We’re so very excited to introduce our newest free weekly event, open to all ages, family & pet-friendly
If you haven’t experienced Jazz Brunch yet, here’s what you can expect: from the moment the music begins, the taproom fills with that perfect weekend energy… laid-back jazz, fresh brunch plates, great beer, and a room full of people settling in and staying awhile. Friends gather around tables, conversations flow easily, and the rhythm of the music sets the tone for a perfect, easy Saturday. It’s exactly the kind of atmosphere we hoped to create when this idea first came to life!
We’re especially excited to continue working with our house Jazz band, “Four Peanuts”, whose smooth, soulful sound brings everything together. The group explores both original compositions and zesty covers of tunes you may or may not know. The trio features Alex Taub on keyboards, Brennan Dugan on bass, and Joe Enri

item.title: 474 Gallery Studio Fundraiser — Sat Nov 21, 12:00 PM — New Belgium Brewing
item.description:
We’re throwing a community fundraiser for 474 Gallery Studio on Saturday, November 21, from noon to 6 PM at New Belgium Brewing! After being displaced by the I-240 highway expansion, we’re working hard to finish building our new home in West Asheville, and we could use your support getting there. We’ll have live music, a silent auction featuring local artists and businesses, live painting by local artists, plus live screen printing by Jerry Cahill. Come hang out, enjoy the afternoon, support local art, and help us get the new studio across the finish line!
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Womansong of Asheville: We Are Multitudes Choral Music Concert — Sat Nov 21, 3:00 PM — Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Asheville
item.description:
Womansong is back again with a beautiful concert highlighting the words of Walt Whitman, “We Are Multitudes!”
Join Womansong for our fall concert series, “We Are Multitudes!” Inspired by the Walt Whitman quote, “I contain multitudes,” our music celebrates the varied and multifaceted nature of women. Songs range from feminist banners like Helen Reddy’s “I Am Woman” and Aretha Franklin’s “Respect” to a few new tunes we picked up at the Sister Singers Festival in Chicago this past summer. Mark your calendars and join us for an show with live singing, full band and positive community!
Doors open 30 min before performance Free for children under 12 years old Limited parking – carpooling recommended Tickets $25 at the door if available Event Details and Tickets
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

Happy hitting!
- Scott

item.title: Manifesting Self — Thu Dec 24, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **Location Change:** **Disclaimer: In all efforts to keep this Meetup a safe space, we all agree to keep anything said within the group private and confidential.**
Do you want to take your remote working game to the next level? Do you find yourself saying wtf is Manifesting Self??
Well, you’re not alone. Remote working is glamorous, and also presents itself with challenges not seen in the traditional office environment.
Manifesting Self may sound a little out there. Trust me. It’s not. Whether we’ve been in the remote space for years, since the pandemic, or just recently, I’m certain it has changed each of us in ways we never thought possible. Let’s explore that together. The highs, the lows, and everywhere in between. And from there experience growth.
We are so excited to see you, again or for the first time!
Source: AVL Digital Nomads

CJ O'Reilly has been creating ecstatic dance waves for the Asheville community since 2014. item.title: Ecology as a Global System — Wed Jan 20, 1:00 PM
item.description: Ecology as a Global System with Lauren Lampley Wednesday, January 20 | 1 – 3 pm BRN – Elective Register Here! Ever wondered why our storm systems almost always come from the west? Or why certain faces of mountain slopes are dryer than others? Sometimes while we study the ecology of a landscape, we forget that this small region we are studying is just a part of a global system. During this class we will look at how global wind patterns and ocean currents affect the amount of rainfall that we get here in Western North Carolina from year to year. Lauren Lampley began her career at Grandfather Mountain Stewardship Foundation as a Park Naturalist which solidified Lauren’s interests in ecology and a passion for teaching others. She has led walks and hikes in a variety of subjects from Geology to Birding and especially enjoys learning and teaching about our local ecology. item.title: The B-Sides — Fri Jan 22, 8:30 PM
item.description:
The B-Sides are a five-piece rock-soul fusion band that was born out of late-night jam sessions attheir college rehearsal space within the mountains of Western NC. Blending the raw energy of rockwith the depth and groove of soul, the band has built a sound that’s both electric and heartfelt. Eachof the five members brings their own unique background and influence, creating a dynamic andsometimes quit eclectic mix of style and taste.
Now stepping beyond the campus stages of Montreat and into the professional music world, the
B-Sides are dedicated to carving out their own space. Their music is about connection; aboutbringing people together in the same way they were brought together in the first place.Music 8:30-11:30pm $10 cover at the door.
Source: Jack of the Wood
